expected_level_description: You can: - plan campaigns that change behaviour, such as encouraging patients to use a digital service - use audience insight and evaluation to improve campaigns - plan communications for incidents and service outages
You can: - handle sensitive and reactive media enquiries, including about incidents or data breaches - brief and prepare spokespeople - build relationships with health and technology journalists

You can: - plan internal communications for major change, such as a new clinical system - advise leaders on how to engage staff and handle difficult messages - use feedback and data to improve channels
You can: - manage the organisation's digital channels and their content plans - handle negative or misleading posts, including during incidents - use analytics to improve reach and engagement
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
